name: Sum of Squares Frequency Disguise
description: Replaces the product of unique element counts with the sum of squares of coordinate frequencies over the chosen set. Because exactly k relays are chosen, the minimum possible sum of squares for each coordinate is k, which occurs if and only if all frequencies are 0 or 1. Thus, the sum equals 3k if and only if the chosen items form a 3-dimensional matching. This hides the exact cover structure behind a non-linear algebraic condition.
